text_block_list.text:
(Well, true...
Studying past runs isn't a bad idea, after all.)

Later on, when handing over the video data,
I also included a notebook summarizing
my impressions as a Trainer.

Although they looked annoyed,
they still accepted it, so with a sense of relief, you proceeded with training.

text_block_list.text: Win, win, and keep on winning—

text_block_list.text:
I'll climb to such great heights
that no one can ever find fault with me...!

"...Sigh.
There's no point in you getting all worked up."

Of course I'm fired up, I'm your Trainer!

text_block_list.text:
As she rattled off plans to review the training menu
immediately upon returning and prepare for the next race—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
We're winning next time.
So none of that depressing attitude!

Though she seemed slightly exasperated,
it looks like she's fired up to aim for victory.
